ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, $AB=5\,cm$, and $BC=13\,cm$. Point $D$ is on line segment $AC$, and $CD=7\,cm$. Moving point $P$ starts from point $E$, which is $15\,cm$ away from point $B$, and moves in the direction of ray $EA$ at a speed of $2\,cm$ per second, for a time of $t$ seconds. Express the length of $AP$ in centimeters as an algebraic expression containing $t$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $BE=15$ and $AB=5$,\\
therefore $AE=20$,\\
thus when $P$, $A$ coincide, $t=\frac{20}{2}=10$,\\
therefore for $0\le t\le 10$, $AP=\left(20-2t\right)\text{cm}$,\\
when $t>10$, $AP=\left(2t-20\right)\text{cm}$.\\
$\therefore \boxed{AP=\left(20-2t\right)\text{cm} \text{ for } 0\le t\le 10}$,\\
$\boxed{AP=\left(2t-20\right)\text{cm} \text{ for } t>10}$.

Moving point $P$ starts from point $E$, which is $15\,cm$ away from point $B$, and moves in the direction of ray $EA$ at a speed of $2\,cm$ per second, for a time of $t$ seconds. Express the length of $AP$ in centimeters as an algebraic expression containing $t$.
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $BE=15$ and $AB=5$,\\
therefore $AE=20$,\\
thus when $P$, $A$ coincide, $t=\frac{20}{2}=10$,\\
therefore for $0\le t\le 10$, $AP=\left(20-2t\right)\text{cm}$,\\
when $t>10$, $AP=\left(2t-20\right)\text{cm}$.\\
$\therefore \boxed{AP=\left(20-2t\right)\text{cm} \text{ for } 0\le t\le 10}$,\\
$\boxed{AP=\left(2t-20\right)\text{cm} \text{ for } t>10}$

ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, the base is a horizontal straight line, and points A, B, P, E are on the same straight line from left to right in order, that is, the order is A-B-P-E. Point C is above A, AC is perpendicular to the horizontal line, and there is a right-angle mark at A; point D is on AC. In the figure, P is located between B and E, and the problem states that moving point P starts from E and moves along the direction of ray EA, that is, along the horizontal line to the left, toward A.

Then reason: From the problem, BE=15 cm, and AB=5 cm. Because it can be seen from the figure that B is between A and E, AE=AB+BE=5+15=20 cm. The speed of moving point P is 2 cm/s, and after moving for t seconds, the distance traveled from E is EP=2t.

When P has not yet reached A, it is necessary that 2t≤20, that is 0≤t≤10; at this time AP is AE minus the already traveled distance EP, so AP=20-2t.

When P passes A, that is t>10, at this time AP is the distance beyond A, so AP=2t-20.

Therefore the length of AP should be expressed piecewise.
